# A small flowsheet with a recycle loop, refined into PFD steps. examples/process-blocks/ holds
# the same flowsheet before refinement: the stream ids are the same and so are the block
# balances. Regenerate the sheets with `cheme process build` (never edit process/*.xml).
schema: cheme/process/v1
kind: flowsheet
title: Ethanol recovery with recycle
units:
  pressure: kPa(a)
  temperature: K
  flow: kg/h
  duty: kW
  enthalpy: kJ/kmol
cases:
  - {id: design, description: Design case, default: true}
tolerance: {abs: 1.0, rel: 0.005}

feeds:
  - id: FEED
    title: Aqueous feed
    ports: [{id: out, direction: out}]
  - id: STEAM
    title: LP steam
    ports: [{id: q, direction: out, kind: energy}]
products:
  - id: PROD
    title: Ethanol product
    ports: [{id: in, direction: in}]
  - id: WATER
    title: Waste water
    ports: [{id: in, direction: in}]

blocks:
  - id: MIX
    title: Feed preparation
    class: Mixing
    ports:
      - {id: feed, direction: in}
      - {id: recycle, direction: in}
      - {id: out, direction: out}
  - id: SEP
    title: Ethanol separation
    class: SeparatingByThermalProcess
    ports:
      - {id: in, direction: in}
      - {id: reboil, direction: in, kind: energy}
      - {id: top, direction: out}
      - {id: side, direction: out}
      - {id: bottom, direction: out}

steps:
  - id: M1
    block: MIX
    title: Feed mixer
    class: MixingSimple
    ports:
      - {id: feed, direction: in, delegates: feed}
      - {id: recycle, direction: in, delegates: recycle}
      - {id: out, direction: out, delegates: out}
    links: [{target: equipment, ref: M-101}]
  - id: C1
    block: SEP
    title: Column
    class: Distilling
    ports:
      - {id: in, direction: in, delegates: in}
      - {id: reboil, direction: in, kind: energy, delegates: reboil}
      - {id: vapour, direction: out}
      - {id: side, direction: out, delegates: side}
      - {id: bottom, direction: out, delegates: bottom}
    links: [{target: equipment, ref: C-101}]
  - id: E1
    block: SEP
    title: Condenser
    class: Cooling
    ports:
      - {id: in, direction: in}
      - {id: out, direction: out, delegates: top}
    links: [{target: equipment, ref: E-101}]

streams:
  - id: S1
    title: Feed
    from: FEED.out
    to: M1.feed
    template: aqueous
    state:
      design:
        pressure: {value: 300, provenance: given, source: basis of design}
        temperature: {value: 298.15, provenance: given, source: basis of design}
        flow: {value: 1000, basis: mass, provenance: given, source: basis of design}
        composition: {basis: mass_fraction, values: {ETOH: 0.4, H2O: 0.6}, provenance: given, source: basis of design}
  - id: S2
    title: Column feed
    from: M1.out
    to: C1.in
    template: aqueous
    state:
      design:
        pressure: {value: 250, provenance: assumed}
        temperature: {value: 330, provenance: assumed}
        flow: {value: 1500, provenance: assumed}
        composition: {basis: mass_fraction, values: {ETOH: 0.3, H2O: 0.7}, provenance: assumed}
  - id: S3
    title: Distillate
    from: E1.out
    to: PROD.in
    template: aqueous
    state:
      design:
        pressure: {value: 110, provenance: assumed}
        flow: {value: 400, provenance: given, source: product specification}
        composition: {basis: mass_fraction, values: {ETOH: 0.95, H2O: 0.05}, provenance: given, source: product specification}
  - id: S4
    title: Recycle
    from: C1.side
    to: M1.recycle
    template: aqueous
    state:
      design:
        flow: {value: 500, provenance: assumed}
        composition: {basis: mass_fraction, values: {ETOH: 0.1, H2O: 0.9}, provenance: assumed}
  - id: S5
    title: Bottoms
    from: C1.bottom
    to: WATER.in
    template: aqueous
    state:
      design:
        flow: {value: 600, provenance: assumed}
        composition: {basis: mass_fraction, values: {ETOH: 0.0333333, H2O: 0.9666667}, provenance: assumed}
  - id: S6
    title: Overhead vapour
    from: C1.vapour
    to: E1.in
    template: aqueous
    state:
      design:
        flow: {value: 400, provenance: assumed}
        composition: {basis: mass_fraction, values: {ETOH: 0.95, H2O: 0.05}, provenance: assumed}
        phase: {value: vapor, vapor_fraction: 1.0, provenance: assumed}
  - id: Q1
    title: Reboiler duty
    kind: energy
    from: STEAM.q
    to: C1.reboil
    state:
      design:
        duty: {value: 350, provenance: assumed}
